sources.title: RobinHood AI Trader
sources.snippet: RobinHood AI Trader Autonomous AI trading bot powered by Robinhood's official MCP server and your choice of LLM (Claude, GPT-4, Gemini, Groq, and more). Self-host anywhere with Docker Compose in one command.

sources.title: Robinhood Unveils In-App AI Agents That Can Trade on Customers' Behalf
sources.snippet: Robinhood unveiled Robinhood Agents at HOOD Summit 2026 in Houston. The in-app AI agents can analyze markets, build strategies, and trade on a customer's behalf.

sources.title: YizhiSong/FriesTrader: Robinhood Agentic Trading agent - GitHub
sources.snippet: An AI trading agent built to run cheap and fully on its own, trading real orders on Robinhood using its Agentic Trading MCP server. Once set up, it's able to run unattended on its own schedule every weekday, no manual triggering needed, and the actual safety mechanism is mechanical, auditable risk rules, not the model's judgment. Two short scheduled Claude Code sessions a day screen stocks ...

sources.title: GitHub - NikhilMiddaGeek/Robinhood-AI-Agent
sources.snippet: Robinhood AI Agent — Autonomous Stock-Trading Assistant A personal AI trading assistant that, every US market open, screens stocks, analyzes them with the Claude API, applies hard-coded risk rules, and proposes trades — then waits for your approve/reject before anything executes. No trade ever fires without a human sign-off.
